editorial.blurb: Bumper 2 Burger is a fresh, made-to-order spot in Logan Square where every burger, hand-cut fry, and crispy onion ring hits the mark.
editorial.insiderTip: Go early or be prepared for the rush—everything's made fresh on the spot, and locals are already lining up for the Bumper Burger with their signature sauce and Cajun fries.

topDishes.note: The signature sauce is what keeps people coming back
Light, airy breading with amazing texture
Seasoned perfectly and hard to find these days
